sloka: विशाला नलिनी यत्र प्रभूत कमलोत्पला ।हंस कारण्डव आकीर्णा अप्सरो गण सेविता ॥४-४३-२२॥
transliteration: viśālā nalinī yatra prabhūta kamalotpalā ।haṁsa kāraṇḍava ākīrṇā apsaro gaṇa sevitā ॥4-43-22॥

translations.english: 'There is an exquisite mansion of Kubera built by Visvakarma which, embellished with gold, looks like a pale white cloud.
